epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Visual regression delta < 0.1% against approved mockup
requirements: R1: Implement pixel-perfect layout and visual styling in the web frontend matching approved design asset design/approved/20261117105520-mockup/mockup.html
R2: Verify mobile responsive layout (375px+ viewport) and WCAG contrast conformance without horizontal overflow regressions

slices.title: Implement approved design mockup layout in frontend interface
slices.jtbd: When implementing design updates for this epic, I want to apply the approved mockup layout and styles to frontend/src/App.svelte and src/main/resources/static/index.html, so that the user interface matches approved design asset design/approved/20261117105520-mockup/mockup.html pixel-perfectly
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved design mockup design/approved/20261117105520-mockup/mockup.html,
When the frontend web application is rendered on desktop and mobile viewports (375px - 1440px),
Then the layout, typography, navigation bar, hero presentation, and control components match the approved mockup specification without horizontal scroll overflow.
Given the updated UI elements,
When checked against WCAG accessibility contrast and interactive keyboard focus standards,
Then all buttons, links, and form inputs meet accessible focus and contrast requirements.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero visual defects against approved design mockup
